career_history.title: Software Engineer

Built and maintained the end-to-end test suite using Selenium and pytest, plus the load-testing setup using Locust. Recent work has been on shifting test responsibility into the dev team — moving from QA-as-gate to QA-as-coach. Career has been entirely in QA/test engineering.

career_history.title: Java Developer

Built and maintained multiple production features including the main shopping flow, push notification system, and the offline-first sync layer. Comfortable with the Android framework, Jetpack components, and the typical patterns (MVVM, Hilt, Coroutines). My career has been entirely on mobile so far; interested in expanding into broader backend or platform engineering.
